name: Biomedical & Healthcare
description: Clinical and pharmaceutical terminology for healthcare symposiums and medical conferences.

entries.domain_definition: The structural or genetic capability of an infectious biological agent to cause disease in a host organism.
The investigation or cause, origin, and development pathway of a medical disease or condition.
A medical treatment, procedure, or intervention designed to prevent disease rather than cure it.
The study of bodily absorption, distribution, metabolism, and excretion (ADME) of drugs over time.
The proportion and rate of an administered drug dosage that enters system-wide circulation unchanged.
Arising spontaneously or having an obscure, unknown, or unidentified causal origin.
An illness or adverse effect induced inadvertently by medical examination, procedure, or drug prescription.
The simultaneous presence of two or more chronic medical conditions or diseases in a patient.
The physiological process of arresting blood flow and clotting to stop hemorrhage from damaged vessels.
An infection originating or acquired within a hospital or clinical care facility setting.
